description: This file provides public helper functions and exports for the ACP (Automation Control Plane) runtime, specifically for plugin integrations. It manages imports and re-exports of various runtime components, error handling, and testing utilities.

classes.name: __testing
classes.description: Proxy object aggregating testing helpers from managerTesting and registryTesting modules for plugin testing purposes.

methods.name: __testing.get
methods.description: Retrieves a property from either managerTesting or registryTesting modules.

methods.name: __testing.has
methods.description: Checks if a property exists in either managerTesting or registryTesting modules.

methods.name: __testing.ownKeys
methods.description: Returns combined keys from both managerTesting and registryTesting modules.

methods.name: __testing.getOwnPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Provides property descriptors for properties in either testing module.

ctags.name: __testing
ctags.pattern: /^export const __testing = new Proxy({} as typeof managerTesting & typeof registryTesting, {$/
